title: Nutty Hangover Cure Dumplings
description: A maca and coriander leaf-infused twist on traditional venezuelan arepas, featuring a miso-marinated chicken filling and a nutty macrobiotic sauce.

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.notes: marinated in miso paste, soy sauce, and rice vinegar (omitted for vegan version)

instructions: Combine coriander leaves, soy milk, miso paste, nutmeg, turmeric, and salt in a blender until smooth.
Heat flaxseed oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add arepa flour and stir to coat the chicken.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix together peanut butter and maple syrup until smooth.
Add almond flour and stir until combined.
Roll out the dough to about 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut out rounds using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the peanut butter mixture in the center of each round.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Heat about 1/2 inch of flaxseed oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the dumplings and cook until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve hot with a side of steamed vegetables or a salad.
For a vegan version, omit the chicken and replace with a tofu or tempeh filling.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
